summary.text: Andy Maidment, a military veteran and information technology professional, was the Libertarian Party nominee for the open Missouri 6th District seat and lost the November 3, 2026 election to Chris Stigall.
He had run for the seat twice before and described himself as not a politician.

paragraphs.text: Maidment was born in West Columbia, South Carolina, and, according to his campaign website, has lived in Missouri since age twelve; Ballotpedia lists Park Hill High School as his high school.
He earned a bachelor's degree in history from Missouri State University in 2007, with a minor in economics according to his campaign website.

Maidment served in the U.S. Army from 2000 to 2004 and in the U.S. Army National Guard from 2004 to 2021, according to Ballotpedia; his campaign website and KCUR cite 21 years of service in the Army and Missouri National Guard.
He works as an information technology and cybersecurity professional and describes himself as a father.
Maidment was the Libertarian candidate for the 6th District in 2022 and 2024, losing to Rep. Sam Graves both times.
During the campaign, he emphasized limiting the federal government.
Maidment received 2.3% of the vote to Chris Stigall's 58.7%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
